notes.title: 50% off Halloween Sale Starts NOW!
notes.notes:
Starting Friday, October 28th, Adele: Following the signs is on sale for 50% off for the entire Halloween Weekend!  And since the game was made in Mexico, we have decided to extend the savings in honor of the Day of the Dead!  Sale ends November 2nd!

notes.title: You can now skip the tutorial levels!
notes.notes:
You asked and we listened!  We have added a button to the first level that allows you to skip all the tutorial levels!   

In the first level, when you get to the barn where the first rope hangs down, we have added a button that will allow the player to skip the first 3 tutorial levels and jump directly to more challenging levels.  

We hope you enjoy!  Thanks! 

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25224770/65ed275c3728bac99d1a3556acf2ff47740fcf6e.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25224770/92a5d1a55a1089e2c7ac90d155db8ce33cabedb3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Level 7 Is Fixed!
notes.notes:
We just want to let everyone know that we were able to fix the bug that was causing problems in level 7 of the game.  We would like to thank everyone who brought this to our attention and for all your patience.  

All you need to do is update the game in Steam (if you haven't already) and the fix is included in the update.  Thank you again for your help and support!
